model_description: DINOv2-large backbone (Apache 2.0) with a segmentation head, fine-tuned on hand-labelled 250 m squares in Laredo (130) and Plano (33)
imagery: USDA NAIP 2022, 0.6 m, 4-band (via Microsoft Planetary Computer)
validation_set: 31 held-out random 250 m squares in Laredo, hand-labelled and never used in training
by_land_use_note: By land use: all 148 labelled random squares (most also used in training, so about 2-3 points optimistic)

calibration.method: Combined ratio estimator over 6 land-use strata (label area / mapped area on held-out random squares) times the mapped citywide total; survey-only figure uses all 148 random squares

notes: Precision first: about 9 of 10 mapped square metres are surface parking; the map misses about a quarter of parking (small lots, apartment parking, lots under trees).
Lots on land with no parcel in the appraisal data (public and exempt land: schools, churches, government) are kept and flagged exempt; they are less certain (79% precision).
Surface type (paved vs gravel) is not distinguished: models could not learn it from 0.6 m imagery.
